author: Learn Linux TV
description:
Ubuntu 26.10 “Stonking Stingray” is here! In this review, we’ll explore what’s new in Ubuntu 26.10, take a look at its desktop improvements, and more. Ubuntu feels faster and more responsive, but does that mean you should upgrade?

I’ll explore the good, the bad, and everything in between - including one important reason you might want to stick with Ubuntu 26.04 LTS for now.
